service_requests.function: Internet Access and Data Transmission Service
service_requests.description: The District is seeking the following C2 equipment and services (see also attachments for details); please note numbers below correspond to table positions above:1., 2a. & 3a. Approximately 1 Palo Alto PA-5440 firewall or equivalent and approx. 3 Palo Alto PAN-PA-5440-BND-CORESEC-5YR-R subscription licenses or equivalent. License may fall under Internal Connections, Basic Maintenance or Managed Internal Broadband Service. Please also bid 1 and 3 year licenses.2b. Approximately 3 Palo Alto PAN-SVC-PREM-5440-R licenses or equivalent. Please bid 1, 3 and 5 year licenses.2c. Time and Materials Maintenance for 3 Palo Alto 5440 or equivalent Firewalls. Please quote 150 hours and a $50,000 break/fix materials allowance. All hours and allowance to be used only if authorized by District during E-rate funding year 2027.3b. Managed Internal Broadband Service for 1 new and 2 existing Palo Alto 5440 or equivalent Firewalls. Please include quotes for full management, monitoring, configuration, redesigns as needed, day to day operation, software upgrades, alerting, license management, manufacturer ticket opening & closing & maintaining the full use features & functionality purchased on the firewalls. Please see attachment for details.4. Managed Internal Broadband Service for approximately 18 Aruba Controllers/Gateways (S0V03AAE). Please include quotes for full management, monitoring, configuration, redesigns as needed, day to day operation, software upgrades, alerting, license management, manufacturer ticket opening & closing & maintaining the full use features & functionality purchased on the wireless controllers/gateways. Please see attachment for details.5. Time and Materials Maintenance for 18 Aruba Controllers/Gateways (S0V03AAE). Please quote 150 hours and a $50,000 break/fix materials allowance. All hours and allowance to be used only if authorized by District during E-rate funding year 2027.6. Managed Internal Broadband Service for up to 468 Juniper Switches.  Please include quotes for full management, monitoring, configuration, redesigns as needed, day to day operation, software upgrades, alerting, license management, manufacturer ticket opening & closing & maintaining the full use features & functionality purchased on the switches. Please see attachment for details.7. Time and Materials Maintenance for up to 468 Juniper Switches. Please quote 150 hours and a $50,000 break/fix materials allowance. All hours and allowance to be used only if authorized by District during E-rate funding year 2027. Please see attachment for more details.8. Approx. 175 LIEBERT PSI5-2200RT120N or equivalent UPSs. UPS must have included (not separately priced) network management card. Please quote installation as well, including rackmount.9. &. 10. & 11. Approximately 1500 Juniper AP36 or equivalent; please include appropriate mounting brackets and wireless licenses, including all necessary AP licensing; Licenses/software may be IC, MIBs, and/or BMIC depending on a type of licenses and/or software, please bid 1, 3 and 5 year licenses.12. & 13. & 14. Approximately 90 Juniper EX4000 -12MP or equivalent. Please include all relevant licensing as well as approx. 90 Juniper SFPP-10G-SR-C (MMF) or equivalent as well as any other switch component parts that may be necessary, such as fiber patch cables, modules, etc. Licenses may be listed under Internal Connections, MIBS or BMIC. Please bid 1, 3 and 5 year licenses.15. & 16. & 17. Cable Management for MDFs at 16 Locations. Walkthrough may be available upon request. Please include pricing for various lengths of Cat6 and Cat6a patch cords between 6 in. and 3 ft. (Please see attached Scope of Work & Location List).Please also include all applicable licenses/software, shipping, installation, configuration, and any other associated charges to the quoted products.

Mitchell Community Schools (the Applicant) is seeking proposals for a project to supply network licenses and/or equipment at its eligible locations.  Bidders are advised that this project will be contingent upon the successful obtaining of Category 2 E-Rate funding, and the contract agreement between the district and the successful bidder must recognize that contingency. The Applicant seeks an agreement that allows it to work with the selected vendor to adjust quantities and/or scale back or cancel the project entirely as needed based upon funding availability and/or the best interests of the Applicant.Vendor installation is not being requested.____________________________________________Questions No informational meetings or building visits will be scheduled.  Any questions related to the technical aspects of this document should be directed to Sam Klawitter, Technology Director at [redacted] , no later than 1pm local time on August 21st, 2026.  Answers to any written questions or any additional information, revisions, or clarifications to the RFP will be provided in the form of an addendum to be posted with the FCC Form 470 on the Universal Service (E-Rate) website.  It is the sole responsibility of the Service Provider to check for any addenda that may be issued.________________________________________Proposal DeliveryThe Applicant reserves the right to reject each and every bid, and to waive informalities, irregularities, and errors in the bidding to the extent permitted by law.  This includes the right to extend the date and time for receipt of bids.  In the event that a responsible bid is not received or if it is determined that the low bid received is too high, the bid received will be rejected and the project will be cancelled or re-bid.  Bids should e-mailed to the office of Sam Klawitter, Technology Director at [redacted]  by 1pm local time on September 18th, 2026._______________________________-Technical Contact:  Sam Klawitter, Technology Director at [redacted]

Vendors must provide itemized pricing, identify any ineligible components, and include all required E Rate documentation.

service_requests.function: Internet Access and Data Transmission Service
Switches and Necessary Software and Licenses
service_requests.description: We are seeking proposals for five (5) managed network switches (similar in performance and specification to the Extreme Networks 5120-24XT switch, or functional equivalent), each equipped with 24 ports supporting 10Gbps (10GbE) connectivity (including fiber/SFP+ support) and high-speed uplink capacity, alongside professional installation, activation, and initial configuration services. Proposed hardware and implementation services must deliver seamless interoperability, full feature compatibility, and unified management integration with the district's existing Extreme Networks switch infrastructure (including 440G2, 460G2, 5520, and 5540 series), or provide a functionally equivalent solution. All bids for equivalent equipment and services must demonstrate that the proposed hardware supports identical management protocols (such as ExtremeCloud IQ / Universal Hardware feature sets), standard 10G fiber optic transceivers, VLAN standards, and stacking/uplink performance without requiring architectural redesigns, additional software licensing, or network re-configuration. Vendor scope of work must include physical mounting, labor, firmware updates, port configuration, VLAN tagging, and initial turn-up testing.

service_requests.function: Firewall Service, Components, and Necessary Software and Licenses
service_requests.description: We are seeking proposals for a Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW) solution to replace the current district-owned Fortinet FortiGate 1101E appliance. The scope of this project encompasses hardware procurement, system configuration, and technical training services. The proposed firewall will reside at a single central location within the district, serving as the single gateway for all inbound and outbound internet traffic.The district is requesting an upgraded Fortinet FortiGate model (or functionally equivalent appliance) engineered to optimize high-performance network throughput with deep SSL inspection, Intrusion Prevention (IPS), and advanced threat mitigation. The proposal must include a five-year support and service bundle, equivalent to a 5-year FortiCare and FortiGuard UTM bundle covering hardware replacement, technical support, and firmware upgrades. Included security service subscriptions must feature Application Control, dynamic CIPA-compliant Web Filtering, AntiSpam email security, Intrusion Prevention (IPS), and Advanced Malware Protection (encompassing antivirus, mobile malware, botnet protection, Content Disarm & Reconstruction [CDR], and Virus Outbreak Protection). The device must also natively support flexible SSL/VPN capabilities for both site-to-site and individual device-level remote connections.The winning vendor will be responsible for deployment, including network integration, rule set migration, and full operational verification. Furthermore, vendors must include structured, hands-on training and knowledge transfer for district IT staff to ensure smooth administrative handoff and ongoing management.Protecting existing district investments and minimizing disruption to ongoing operations are critical priorities. Any vendor proposing an alternative hardware or software brand outside the specified Fortinet architecture must guarantee full, seamless interoperability with the districts existing reporting platform (or supply a functionally equivalent enterprise-grade reporting and logging service at no additional charge). Alternative solutions must integrate smoothly into the district's current network infrastructure without requiring extensive retraining of IT personnel.

service_requests.description: New Richmond Exempted Village School District (NREVSD) is seeking proposals for Category 2 Internal Connections equipment (specifically network switches, transceiver optics, stacking cables, and associated software/licensing) to replace aging End-of-Life (EoL) infrastructure across four district school buildings:1. New Richmond High School (NRHS)2. New Richmond Middle School (NRMS)3. Locust Corner Elementary (LCE)4. Monroe ElementaryEQUIPMENT SPECIFICATIONS:Pursuant to FCC/USAC guidelines, all manufacturer part numbers referenced in our attached RFP or line-item requests (Cisco Catalyst 9300X, 9200, 9200L, SFP+ optics, and stacking accessories) represent the District's baseline specifications. Bids for functionally equivalent equipment (e.g., Aruba, Ruckus/CommScope, Extreme, Juniper) with parity features, throughput, PoE budget, and management capabilities will be fully evaluated and accepted.VENDOR DISQUALIFICATION FACTORS:Bids will be disqualified prior to evaluation if any of the following mandatory requirements are not met:1. Vendor does not possess an active E-Rate Service Provider Identification Number (SPIN).2. Vendor is not in good standing ("Green Light" status) with the FCC/USAC.3. Proposal fails to include "or equivalent" pricing if non-baseline hardware is quoted.4. Proposal is submitted past the explicit 28-day deadline specified in the RFP.5. Proposal requires full upfront payment without supporting the SPI (Service Provider Invoice - Form 474) billing process.BILLING & DELIVERY:All equipment delivered under this contract must be itemized by physical site (Billed Entity Number) on all invoices.

Temecula Valley Charter School would like quotes for the following products and services for this new address - 35780 Washington St, Winchester, CA 92596: Switching Needs: 10 HPE Aruba CX 6100 48G Class4 PoE 4SFP+ 370W Switches (JL675A) or equivalent and all related components 10 switch licenses, one for each of the above switches, (preferably Foundational Care or equivalent). Please provide quotes for 3-year licenses or equivalent. 1 HPE Aruba Networking CX 6300M 24 port SFP+ and 4 port SFP56 Switch (JL658A) or equivalent and all related components 1 license for the switch above (preferably Foundational Care or equivalent). Please provide quotes for 3-year licenses or equivalent. 2 FN-TRAN-SFP+GC Fiber Transceivers or equivalent and all related components UPSs (10) 1000 VA (1 kVA) rack mountable battery backup/surge protectors or equivalent and all related components. The school would prefer the following power plug type for the UPSs: North American (120V / 15A) Standard NEMA 5-15P and NEMA 5-15R or equivalent. service_requests.description: This RFP is a supplemental bid for additional product lines to be added to the PA State PEPPM Contract beginning January 1, 2027. There are 114 product lines included in this procurement, of which 11 offer E-Rate eligible products and services. Each eligible product line has been added to the Form 470 as Category 2 for each unique category of service it serves, for both internal connections, and basic maintenance. Further, the product lines featuring network related equipment also are included as a Category 1 Network Equipment bid. Also, the form does not permit the addition of manufacturer name to the managed internal broadband category, so a single entry has been made for all product lines being bid representing that category. Vendors interested in adding equivalent product lines should note the specific process, requirements and timelinefor doing so in the Bid Documents. The form does not permit the addition of manufacturer name to the C1 Network Equipment drop down, so a single entry has been made for all product lines being bid representing that category and those product lines are listed in the C1 narrative./The current Form 470 format requires the unit quantity. The PEPPM Contract is bid on the quantity of one to establish a unit contract price. LEAs then conduct a mini bid process, described in the RFP Terms and Conditions, by seeking bids for specific products, services, quantities from all awarded product lines in the specific category. A single contract is then signed with the lowest responsible, qualified bidder.Note: the Form 470 states that the PA State PEPPM Consortium _ Central Susquehanna Intermediate Unit _ is the Billed Entity which is not accurate. Although CSIU will sign a single contract with the lowest responsible, qualified bidder for each product line, each LEA will sign its own separate contract with the lowest responsible bidder resulting from a PEPPM mini bid procurement and file the Form 471 as their own Billed Entity./The Form 470 also requires the number of entities served. In PA, all public schools, nonpublic schools and libraries may purchase from this cooperative purchasing contract. However, more than 835 specific PA schools, libraries and consortia have submitted electronic E-rate Letters of Agency and may be use this contract for E-rate eligible purchases.  Prospective bidders should note that this is the maximum number of entities that may be seeking mini-bids from awarded vendors, not the actual number of entities that will be requesting mini-bids. Since FY 2021, more than $109 million has been requested as the pre-discount cost for E-rate eligible equipment using the PA State PEPPM Contract mini-bid procurement process. /The E-Rate eligible product lines, or their equivalents, included on this 470 are as follows:/Arista NetworksBeldenCables2GoLowell Manufacturing CompanyReadyLinksRiverbedSamsungSolarWindsTripp LiteUbiquitiVivi/All bidding documents are included in this RFP. These are the identical documents that are attached to the online Form 470. The term of the PEPPM contracts shall be January 1, 2027  December 31, 2028, with an optional 1-year extension, unless otherwise terminated or cancelled. All disqualification criteria are listed in the Terms and Conditions of the attached RFP./The E-Rate Category List identifies possible categories for each manufacturer were identified using our best ability.   Should any vendor or manufacturer notice any changes that should be made to the E-rate Category List or additional product lines that should be added to this procurement, they should submit these suggestions, additions or potential changes to [redacted] by the Exceptions Due Date.  /Vendors should review all of the bid documents carefully before submitting questions. Questions about the bid must be submitted within the Epylon eBid form on the "Bidder's Questions" tab by the due date outlined in the RFP.  A Pre-Bid Conference is scheduled for August 20, 2026, 11 am Eastern Time.  See the "PEPPM_2027_Product_Line_Bid_Pennsylvania_Terms_and_Conditions" document for full details. The deadline to submit proposals is October 8, 2026, 3 pm Eastern Time.

Please note there is a pricing attachment for Project (1) and Project (2) the offeror is responding to.Note: as it relates to cabling the quantity of 450 is reflected, as well as the total feet per drop based on industry standard. It will be up to the offeror to provide the final length of cabling.

Lewis County School District (the Applicant) is seeking proposals for a project to supply and install structured cabling at an eligible site.  Bidders are advised that this project will be contingent upon district approval and the successful obtaining of Category 2 E-Rate funding, and the contract agreement between the Applicant and the successful bidder must recognize that contingency.  Bidders should also understand that this RFP is essentially for time and materials pricing and the district reserves the right to scale this project back substantially or to cancel it entirely, regardless of the status of E-Rate funding. Contractor will supply pricing for time and materials to install up to a total of 450 +/- Category 6A  plenum cable runs, each of an average of 250 feet at Tollesboro Elementary School, Address: 2431 KY 10, Tollesboro, KY 41189, and terminated in vendor-supplied patch panels in IDF/MDF. All cabling and hardware at all locations shall be Panduit product or equivalent. The Lewis County School District will not accept the use of subcontractors on this project.A voluntary site visit will be held at Lewis County Technology Office, 65 Central Elementary VANCEBURG, KY 41179 at 3:00pm EST on September 9, 2026.  This will be the only opportunity to ask questions or to receive answers to questions related to this RFP.  Respondents choosing not to attend in so doing acknowledge their understanding that they were offered and voluntarily declined the opportunity.All proposals must include the following information:1.	Per- run pricing for each item included in your bid.  Any discounting applied to your proposal must be reflected at the line-item level.  2.	Two (2) reference sites where your company has performed a similar work as that being bid, including business name, contact name and contact information.  It is preferable that at least one reference should be for a school corporation or library system within 100 miles of the Applicant.3.	Your E-Rate SPIN Number.  (You must have a current SPAC form on file with USAC.)4.	A ready-to-execute contract which includes the proposal requirements and the E-Rate contingencies outlined herein.The Applicant requires that the selected vendor be willing to utilize the E-Rate SPI form of invoicing (discounted invoices).Bids should e-mailed to the office of Quentin Allen at [redacted] by 10:00am EST on September 24, 2026.All proposals must reflect the LCP (Lowest Corresponding Price), GSA pricing, and any available governmental unit discounts including existing state purchasing agreements or contracts when applicable.  Any proposal referencing an existing state purchasing agreement or contract must include that information in the proposal.  Bid prices must be complete for the services proposed and shall include all associated costs, even if the amounts are estimates based upon current applicable taxes, surcharges, or fees.  No proposal can be submitted that includes equipment or components for equipment from companies deemed to provide a national security risk as defined by FCC Order 19-121.

service_requests.description: Chelsea Public Library is seeking bids to replace end-of-life internal network infrastructure. The project includes one (1) 24-port PoE network switch, one (1) UPS/battery backup, fourteen (14) new network data drops, and two (2) wireless access points consisting of one indoor access point and one outdoor-rated access point to extend the library's network connectivity to the immediate exterior library property.For the Cabling service request, the quantity of 14 represents fourteen (14) network drops, not fourteen feet of cable. Bidders should determine the actual cable footage necessary to complete the 14 drops. Cabling should include all necessary eligible components, terminations, connectors, jacks/faceplates, patching, testing, labeling, and related installation.The project also includes relocation of the existing network rack as necessary to accommodate installation of the requested eligible network equipment. Bids should include installation, activation, initial configuration, and all eligible components and materials necessary for a complete and functional installation.Equivalent equipment that meets or exceeds the library's requirements will be considered. The library has no manufacturer preference.

The Commonwealth of Kentucky is seeking state master contract(s) to establish contract pricing for a procurement vehicle for E-rate eligible networking hardware, software, and services. Details are set forth in the RFP. Eligible entities of 175 represents all KY K-12 public school districts, not school buildings. Listed quantities of 1 are placeholders. Specific quantities needed are unknown at this time as this procurement is to intended to establish statewide pricing vehicles to be available to all public K-12 districts (170+ school districts comprised of 1700+ school buildings and non-instructional facilities) in the Commonwealth rather than a contract for a specific purchase. EPC does not allow for distinction between different types of eligible equipment under C1. See RFP for details on equipment and functionality sought. EPC's 2000 character limit does not allow for the inclusion of all mandatory requirements. Instead, see attached "Attachment E Mandatory Requirements Checklist RFP 758 2700000070". The installment payment plan option is selected to indicate that leasing options are also being sought as a part of this procurement. See Attachment A for details. The number of entities listed is an indicator of the number of K-12 public school districts which will be eligible to utilize the contract(s) awarded based on this process. There is no guarantee, implied or expressed, of the actual number of devices or services to be procured by the eligible entities under any contract awarded. Procurement activity schedule is as follows: Release of RFP August 28, 2028; Certification of USAC Form 470 August 31, 2026; Optional (but highly recommended) vendor conference Sept 3, 2026, 8am-10am EDT. Vendors MUST email [redacted] by 8:00am EDT on Sept 2, 2026, with their company name, contact name and email address to confirm attendance for the Vendor Conference to receive an email invitation for the MS Teams meeting. Vendor written questions are due Sept 4, 2026, by 9:00 PM EDT and shall be recorded on "Attachment D  Vendors Question Form RFP 758 2700000070" and submitted via email to [redacted]); Commonwealth responses to vendors written questions will be posted September 11, 2026; Proposals are due no later than 3:30 PM EDT, September 28, 2026.

The District is not soliciting separate bids for BMIC or MIBS.SPAM and/or robotic responses will not be considered valid Proposals and will be disqualified from consideration.

The estimated number of feet are for these items.When reviewing a bid, vendors should click the Follow button for update notifications. It is the vendors responsibility to check the USAC website for any addendums.  Bidders must register on PlanetBids to be able to submit a bid or ask questions. Bidders shall create a Free account with PlanetBids by signing up through Chula Vista Elementary School District (https://www.cvesd.org/departments/business-services/purchasing-warehouse-publications/bids-rfq). Once you have completed account registration, select Bid Opportunities on the PlanetBids website and select Bid Invitation # 26/27-5 Network Hardware E-Rate Year 2027/2028 then select Place eBid. Your completed Bid along with all required documents shall be time stamped on or before the time stated above. Late bids or incomplete bids will not be accepted. Failure to follow the guidance of the associated RFP(s) or similar documents may be grounds for bid dismissal.Quantities and Categories outlined in the Service Request Section of this Form 470 are approximate and may be increased or decreased. The details of equipment and quantities can be located within the attached RFP. The quantities may be increased or decreased based on district needs. Service providers responding to the RFP should clearly identify E-rate Eligible and E-rate Ineligible equipment and pricing.Equivalent Manufacturers and part numbers may be proposed. If a Service Provider chooses to bid another manufacturer than is preferred, please provide supporting documentation per the process noted in the RFP.  District reserves the right to cancel the contract if E-Rate Funding is not approved, or if it is not in the best interest of the district. Installation can begin as early as 4/1/27 if USAC is invoiced on, or after, 7/1/27.  Service Provider acknowledges that it is following FCC Order FCC 19-121, which bars the use of USF subsidies to fund equipment, components, and services from covered companies, their parents, affiliates and subsidiaries, deemed to be a national security risk.Ability to add new sites during term of the contract. Ability to add new equipment.  District prefers SPI Method of E-Rate Reimbursement.The District expects Service Providers to make themselves thoroughly familiar with any rules or regulations regarding the E-rate program. Service Providers are required to be in full compliance with all current requirements and future requirements issued by USAC throughout the contractual period of any contract entered into as a result of this RFP.SPAM and/or robotic responses will not be considered valid bid responses and will be disqualified from consideration.Do not contact district by phone.  Contact by email only.   See RFP for Dates, Deadlines, Disqualification Factors and Evaluation Criteria.

MIBS and BMIC dropdowns were listed above in case USAC deems any of the necessary software licenses to fit that category.- 250 +/- Switches including all software, cables, connectors (300 +/-), modules (50 +/-), transceivers (100 +/-), cords, mounting hardware and any other related items as described in the attached RFP.  MIBS and BMIC dropdowns were listed above in case USAC deems any of the necessary software licenses to fit that category.- 540 +/- Access Points including all software, cables, connectors, cords, antennas, mounting hardware and any other related items as described in the attached RFP.  MIBS and BMIC dropdowns were listed above in case USAC deems any of the necessary software licenses to fit that category.- 1 +/- Wireless Controller including all software, cables, connectors, cords, mounting hardware and any other related items as described in the attached RFP.  MIBS and BMIC dropdowns were listed above in case USAC deems any of the necessary software licenses to fit that category.- 2 +/- Firewall including all software, cables, connectors, modules, cords, mounting hardware and any other related items as described in the attached RFP. MIBS and BMIC dropdowns were listed above in case USAC deems any of the necessary software licenses to fit that category.______________________________________________________________________________Questions & AnswersAll questions must be submitted through the Messages section of the RFP posting on the Indigo Procurement Portal:https://indigo.bonfirehub.com by October 8, 2026 , 4 PM Eastern. Only written responses posted in the system are considered official and binding.Respondents may not rely on verbal communications, informal conversations with district personnel, or information obtained from media or social media sources.If any revisions or clarifications to this RFP are required, an Addendum will be issued through the Bonfire portal. IPS may extend the proposal deadline if necessary to accommodate the release of new information.________________________________________________________________________________Proposal Due Date & TimeRespondents must submit a response before 11 AM Eastern on Nobermber 12, 2026. Proposals must be submitted electronically through the Indigo Procurement Portal: https://indigo.bonfirehub.com. Proposals not submitted by the deadline cannot be considered; nor will sending it via email or hand delivery be viable alternatives. The district accepts no obligations for costs incurred by respondents in anticipation of being awarded.

service_requests.function: Firewall Service, Components, and Necessary Software and Licenses
service_requests.description: Exeter R-VI School District is seeking proposals for Category 2 enterprise-grade network infrastructure components, bulk deployment materials, and multi-year manufacturer maintenance support to optimize and secure our district network topology. Equivalent hardware architectures will receive equal consideration based on baseline performance compliance.1. CORE FIREWALL APPLIANCE & SOFTWARESeeking an enterprise-grade security gateway/firewall appliance, Fortinet FortiGate 121G or equivalent. Minimum specifications: 1U Rack-mountable form factor with dual built-in redundant power supplies; performance thresholds of 2.5 Gbps Threat Protection and 4 Gbps SSL Deep Packet Inspection; interfaces must include at least 4 x 10 GE SFP+ slots and 16 x RJ45 Gigabit copper ports; minimum 400 GB built-in, local solid-state storage (SSD) for local historical logging without cloud dependencies. Uplink utilizes standard Cat 6 copper patch cabling via an RJ45 WAN interface. Bids must include multi-year manufacturer support/security bundles (Fortinet UTP or equivalent) with clear cost-allocation metrics separating E-Rate eligible firmware/updates (FortiCare) from ineligible advanced security features (IPS, filtering, malware protection).2. OUTDOOR PTMP WIRELESS MESH BRIDGESeeking an outdoor point-to-multipoint wireless bridge to extend connectivity from the main instructional building to four (4) remote structures (Bus Barn/Practice Area, Outside Concession, AG Storage Building, and Baseball Press Box). Requirements: One (1) outdoor tri-radio 4x4 MIMO access point, Fortinet FortiAP 432F or equivalent, serving as the root bridge hub, paired with a matching wide-angle external 4x4 MIMO directional sector antenna (Fortinet FANT-04ACAX-0606-D-R or equivalent) and mounting brackets. Four (4) outdoor ruggedized 2x2 MIMO access points with high-gain internal directional antennas, Fortinet FortiAP 234F or equivalent, serving as bridge receivers at the four remote structures. All wireless hardware must be IP67-rated weather-resistant and integrate natively via FortiLink. Bids must include matching multi-year manufacturer support/advanced hardware replacement contracts (FortiCare or equivalent).3. LOCAL CAMPUS DISTRIBUTION SWITCHINGSeeking four (4) enterprise-grade 8-port network edge switches, Fortinet FortiSwitch 108F-FPOE or equivalent, for local outbuilding network distribution. Required specifications: Compact desktop/rack form factor with completely fanless architecture; minimum 8 x 10/100/1000 Mbps RJ45 Gigabit Ethernet ports and 2 x dedicated 1GE SFP uplink slots; copper ports must support full PoE+ power budget up to 130W. System must natively support FortiLink deployment architecture for automated, centralized management via our core firewall interface. Bids must include matching multi-year manufacturer support and hardware warranty contracts (FortiCare or equivalent).4. BULK INFRASTRUCTURE & RACK MATERIALSSeeking Category 6 copper infrastructure components and horizontal server rack management. Specifications: 3,000 feet of Category 6 CMP Plenum-rated wire, 100% 23 AWG Solid Bare Copper (Copper Clad Aluminum wire is strictly unacceptable). Bids must include matching standard, non-pass-through RJ45 connectors with built-in load bars, and four (4) external gas-discharge tube in-line Ethernet surge suppression blocks (Ubiquiti ETH-SP-G2 or equivalent) to ground exterior antenna lines. Server room management must include six (6) 1U Horizontal Finger Duct Panels with snap-on covers (StarTech or equivalent) and fabric hook-and-loop bulk cable strapping.CRITICAL VENDOR CONTRACT TERM NOTE: Pre-packaged manufacturer hardware and service bundles ranging across uniform multi-year periods (including standard 3-year options and 5-year promotional factory bundles) will be explicitly accepted and evaluated. Software management licenses, system updates, and basic hardware warranties must be fully compatible with Fortinet architecture to ensure operational continuity. Bidding vendors must clearly break down individual component costs, multi-year subscription lengths, and manufacturer part numbers within final submittals to allow exact cost-allocations on the upcoming Form 471 filing.

service_requests.function: Switches and Necessary Software and Licenses
service_requests.description: Applicant seeks bids for one (1) redundant core switch to mirror an existing Cisco Catalyst 9500 core switch recently deployed at the network core, providing failover redundancy for the school's core network layer. The unit must match or be fully compatible with the existing switch to support redundant/high-availability core operation (e.g., StackWise Virtual or equivalent).Line 001: Cisco Catalyst 9500, 24x 1/10/25G + 4-port 40/100G, Advantage license (Cisco part number C9500-24Y4C-A) - Quantity 1Line 002: 650W AC Config 4 Power Supply, front-to-back cooling (Cisco part number C9K-PWR-650WAC-R) - Quantity 1Scope includes physical installation, initial configuration, and integration with the existing core, including VLANs, trunking, and routing to match current production configuration, and StackWise Virtual pairing with the existing unit.Applicant will disqualify bidders who are not bonded (if applicable) and who do not possess a valid Service Provider Identification Number (SPIN). Bids must include pricing detail by line item: quantity, description, manufacturer, model number, part number/SKU, unit price, extended price, and E-Rate eligibility percentage for each line item (equipment versus non-eligible services such as training). Installation, configuration, and shipping charges must be itemized separately from equipment cost.

service_requests.function: Switches and Necessary Software and Licenses
service_requests.description: DATA EQUIPMENT FOR DISTRICT BUILDINGS. 28X NETWORK SWITCHES, CISCO C9300L-48UXG-4X-E OR EQUIVALENT OR CISCO C9200L-48PXG-4X-E OR EQUIVALENT: 48 COPPER PORTS, MINIMUM POE+ SUPPORT ON ALL ACCESS PORTS. MODULAR UPLINKS PORTS, SFP/SFP+ CAPABLE, 10G CAPABLE. FIXED MULTI-GIG PORTS (12 OR MORE PER SWITCH). 1100W POWER SUPPLY WITH THE CAPABILITY OF HOUSING A SECONDARY PSU AT A LATER DATE. ALL ACCESS PORTS ARE CAPABLE OF AUTO ADJUSTING SPEED (10,100,1000) AND DUPLEX. THE SWITCH MUST BE RACK MOUNTABLE AND THE HARDWARE INCLUDED. THE SWITCH MUST HAVE THE ABILITY TO STACK WITH OTHER SWITCHES IN THE SAME CLOSET. ALL NECESSARY CABLES WILL BE REQUIRED TO STACK WITH EVERY SWITCH. THE SWITCH SHOULD BE ABLE TO BE MANAGED LOCALLY OR OVER THE NETWORK, NOT CLOUD-BASED. THE SWITCH SHOULD BE ABLE TO HANDLE LAYER-3 TRAFFIC AND ALL STANDARD NETWORK AND ROUTING PROTOCOLS. THE SWITCH MUST BE ABLE TO WORK IN OUR CISCO NETWORK WITHOUT ADDITIONAL PURCHASES/SERVICES. ALL REQUIRED LICENSING AND ANY CORDS NEEDED FOR THE DEVICE TO FUNCTION. 110X NETWORK ACCESS POINTS CISCO MERAKI CW9176I OR EQUIVALENT; MUST BE COMPATABLE WITH THE DISTRICTS EXISTING MERAKI WIRELESS CLOUD-CONTROLLED ENVIRONMENT. AP MUST BE WIFI 7 COMPATABLE. AP MUST BE FUNCTIONAL ON POE=(802.3AT) POWER PROVIDED BY LOCAL NETWORK SWITCHES. AP MUST SUPPORT ALL STANDARD WIRED AND WIRELESS TRANSMISSION STANDARDS FOR AP'S. AP MUST BE ABLE TO FUNCTION WHEN POWERED/CONNECTED TO CISCO SWITCHES.  28 NETWORK CONNECTION DEVICE SPF-10G-SR-S OR EQUIVALENT: THE DEVICE MUST BE COMPATIBLE WITH MODERN NETWORK SWITCHES. THE DEVICE SHOULD BE IN SFP/SFP+ FORMAT.THE DEVICE MUST BE ABLE TO SUPPORT BI-DIRECTIONAL SPEEDS OF UP TO 10 GBPS. THE DEVICE SHOULD BE ABLE TO CONNECT LC-STYLE CABLES. THE DEVICE MUST BE CISCO COMPATIBLE.  61X RACK MOUNTABLE UPS EATON TRIPP LITE SMART1500RM2U OR EQUIVALENT: UPS MUST BE RACK MOUNTABLE. UPS MUS BE 2U AT MOST AND FIT IN A STANDARD 19" (INSIDE WIDTH) DATA RACK. UPS MUST BE AT LEASE 1500VA AND 1350W OR HIGHER. UPS POWER CORD MUST BE 5-15P. UPS SHOULD HAVE 8 OR MORE OUTLETS. UPS MUST BE ABLE TO CONDITION POWER TO PROVIDE OUTLETS TO PROTECT END-DEVICES FROM BROWNOUTS AND OVER-VOLTAGES.

USAC advised all applicants to include all three categories of service on each 470.School City of Hammond is seeking proposals for a project to supply network equipment at its eligible locations. There is an RFP document that provides greater detail on the scope of this project. It is important that service providers read the attached document to fully understand this project and prepare a more directed bid. Applicable items should include all related software and hardware components that enable the functionality of the equipment (including any necessary mounting brackets, power cables, multi-year licenses/software, and basic maintenance). Vendors shall specify all fees, shipping charges, taxes, surcharges and contingency fees for eligible equipment. Vendors may submit alternative equipment as long as the equipment is an equivalent make and model, serves a similar functionality, and is compatible with the current network. Include in your proposal, any connectors and / or related components necessary for proper function of the requested items.  The District reserves the right to adjust quantities prior to purchasing to meet the Districts needs._____Questions No informational meetings or building visits will be scheduled.   Any questions related to the technical aspects of this document should be directed to Brian Tucker, Network Engineer, at [redacted] with a copy to [redacted], no later than Noon Central Time on October 16, 2026. Answers to any written questions or any additional information, revisions, or clarifications to the RFP will be provided in the form of an addendum to be posted with the FCC Form 470 on the Universal Service (E-Rate) website.  It is the sole responsibility of the Service Provider to check for any addenda that may be issued._____Proposal Delivery Notice is hereby given that the Board of School Trustees of the School City of Hammond, Hammond, Indiana will receive email bids at [redacted] with a copy to [redacted] until 12pm (noon) Central time on November 13, 2026 at which time they will be reviewed.  Emails containing bids shall be plainly marked Bids for RFP FY2027. Bids received after the designated time will be returned unopened. The District hereby invites all interested bidders to submit a bid to furnish hardware only, and any other related items required under the RFP.Proposals must be submitted as Portable Document Format (PDF) attachments to an email addressed to [redacted]. The Cost Proposal must be submitted as a separate attachment.  Thus, each email submission must have a minimum of two attachments, a narrative proposal, and a cost proposal.  The email must be a direct email to the address; it cannot be a reply or part of a thread.  The subject line of the email must state:  Core Network Upgrade F470 No. 270000910 by Wednesday, November 11, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. (PST).  Proposals received other than through email or after the due date and time shall not be accepted and shall be returned unopened.Any questions and/or objections concerning the substance of this RFP, including the Scope of Work, requirements, and evaluation criteria, must be submitted, in writing, via email to [redacted] by 5:00 P.M. (PDT) on Wednesday, October 28, 2026.  Any questions concerning the RFP process shall be submitted no later than 48 hours prior to the proposal due date to the same email address. The email must be a direct email to this address; it cannot be a reply or part of a thread.  The subject line of the email must state:  QUESTIONS FOR Core Network Upgrade F470 No. 270000910.  Proposers who fail to do so will waive all further rights to protest, based on these specifications and requirements.  If necessary, a Questions and Answers document will be developed from all submitted questions and posted on the Districts contracts opportunities portal: Current RFPs, RFQs, RFOs & RFIs | SFUSD.  It is the responsibility of the Proposer to check the portal for the Questions and Answers document and any addenda.    The District may modify the RFP, prior to the proposal due date, by issuing an addendum, which will be posted on the Districts contracts opportunities portal: Current RFPs, RFQs, RFOs & RFIs | SFUSD.  Proposers shall be responsible for ensuring that their proposals reflect any and all RFP addenda issued by the District prior to the proposal due date, regardless of when their proposal is submitted. All proposed equipment and services must meet or exceed the minimum specifications and requirements outlined in the attached "SCOPE OF SERVICES " document, which includes the detailed Statement of Work, technical specifications, vendor responsibilities, implementation requirements, and proposal pricing instructions.Vendors must review the attached document in its entirety and submit proposals that address all applicable requirements.Line Items 1, 2, 3  and 4 - Purchase, installation, configuration, decommissioning, and engineering of new firewall and 5-year subscriptions, as further detailed in the Statement of Work (SOW).:- +/-1 Palo Alto 3420, SKU PAN-PA-3420, or equivalent. - +/-2 Palo Alto 10G Optical Transceiver Modules, SKU PAN-SFP-PLUS-SR, or equivalent.- +/-1 Palo Alto 5-year security bundle, SKU PAN-PA-3420-BND-PRECISIONAI-5YR, or equivalent.- +/-1 Palo Alto 5-year GlobalProtect subscription, SKU PAN-PA-3420-PAA-5YR, or equivalent.- +/-1 Palo Alto 5-year Premium Support, SKU PAN-SVC-PREM-3420-5YR, or equivalent.Note: Any e-rate ineligible products, services or components bundled with eligible products or services must be listed separately from the eligible products or services; failure to do so can lead to rejection of the bid/quote. service_requests.description: Please see attached BOM and BMIC list.Please submit all bids to the designated Technical Contact listed on the FCC Form 470. Include the Applicant/School or Library name AND FCC Form 470 number in the subject line of the bid submission. The Technical Contact listed on this FCC Form 470 is responsible for responding to vendor questions, collecting vendor bids, and coordinating the distribution of bids to the Applicant. All vendor questions, responses, and bid submissions must be communicated in writing via the Technical Contact email address listed on the FCC Form 470. Uninterruptable Power Supply/Battery Backup and Necessary Software and Licenses
service_requests.description: The McComb School District seeks proposals from qualified vendors to furnish, deliver, install, configure, test, and place into operation a modular rack-mounted Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) solution and associated power distribution equipment supporting eligible network infrastructure used to provide districtwide broadband connectivity, Internet access, and internal network services.The proposed solution is intended to replace existing UPS equipment that is no longer functional. The District anticipates the project will include five (5) UPS power modules and all associated components necessary for a complete operational solution, including but not limited to a UPS chassis, battery modules, power distribution units (PDUs), network management components, environmental monitoring components, startup services, installation services, mounting hardware, and related accessories. Equivalent products and solutions meeting or exceeding the minimum specifications contained in the District's RFP will be considered.This procurement is being conducted in accordance with FCC E-Rate Schools and Libraries Program requirements and applicable federal, state, and local procurement laws. Vendors must comply with all FCC, USAC, and E-Rate program requirements, including possession of a valid Service Provider Identification Number (SPIN).

Fulton SD 58 is seeking a qualified service provider to furnish third-party operation, management, and monitoring of the Districts 275 Aruba Access Points in accordance with Category 2 Managed Internal Broadband Service (management and monitoring of Internal Connections components) within the E-rate program. Service must provide the following:	Provide a platform for managing the connections to the districts wired and/or wireless network.	Enable accurate enforcement of the districts network access policies.	Facilitate network uptime by allowing appropriate connectivity to the network.	Solution must be able to handle 5000 concurrent connections.Fulton SD 58 is comprised of 6 schools and has a total enrollment of 2,177.The service shall be delivered as an ongoing, third-party-managed offering for the duration of the contract term, with the vendor's personnel responsible for actively performing the operation, management, and monitoring functions described above on the District's behalf  as distinct from the District's own staff operating a self-managed platform.ALL INELIGIBLE COSTS MUST BE BROKEN OUT ON THE PRICING PROPOSALS. The deadline to submit questions for this project is October 9, 2026 to Dan Hedgpath at [redacted]. All questions received after the date above will not be accepted. Proposals must be submitted via email no later than October 26, 2026 at 2pm EST to Dan Hedgpath at [redacted]. Proposals received after the due date and time listed above will not be accepted. Please refer to the RFP document for the full scope of requirements.

service_requests.function: Internet Access and Data Transmission Service
Switches and Necessary Software and Licenses
service_requests.description: Requests bids to provide and install 10 managed 48 port network switches, 5 managed 48 port Power over Ethernet (PoE) switches, 55 WiFi 7 wireless access points.All network cabling has already been run. The bid must include connecting every switch to the network by fiber, installing the access points at the existing cable locations, configuring the equipment, and testing the completed system. New cable runs are not part of this request.Required equipment10 Standard network switches	with 48 RJ45 ports supporting 1 Gbps; at least four 10 Gbps SFP+ uplink ports5 PoE network switch with	48 RJ45 ports supporting 1 Gbps and 2.5 Gbps; at least eight ports also supporting 5 Gbps; at least four 10 Gbps SFP+ uplink ports55 Wireless access points with WiFi 7 supporting 2.4 GHz, 5 GHz, and 6 GHz operation; compatible with the proposed PoE switchesAll 5 PoE switches must support IEEE 802.3at PoE+ on all 48 RJ45 ports. At least eight ports per switch must support IEEE 802.3bt with 60 watts available per port. Each PoE switch must have an available power budget of at least 1,100 watts. Bidders must state the total PoE budget and any limits on simultaneous port power use.All switches must be rack mountable and may include mounting hardware (If item is not compatible). Switches must support VLANs, link aggregation, spanning tree, 802.1X authentication, and secure remote management.Installation and fiber connectionsThe bid must include all compatible fiber transceivers and patch cords needed to connect each of the 15 switches to the existing fiber network. The bidder must verify the existing fiber type, connector type, available strands, and connection points, and identify any assumptions or incompatibilities in the bid.Installation must include mounting and connecting the switches and access points; configuring switch uplinks, PoE, and wireless settings in coordination with the organization; and testing fiber connections, access point operation, and network connectivity. The bidder must provide the organization with the final configuration information and test results.Bid response requirementsProvide technical data sheets, warranty terms, estimated delivery and installation schedules. Identify all required licenses or subscriptions and explain how the proposed switches will supply the Ethernet speed and PoE power needed for the 55 access points.Provide separate pricing for the standard switches, PoE switches, access points, fiber transceivers and patch cords, installation, shipping, and required licenses or subscriptions. Include a five year total cost showing any recurring fees. State any exceptions to these requirements. Current system is Cisco C9200 and Meraki MR46. We are open to new systems.  We prefer a system that has a Graphic user interface for the switches. We also would like to use the following cords/connections if allowed:Item	Description	QuantityC9200L-NW-E-48	Network Essentials, 48-port license	10C9200L-DNA-E-48	Cisco DNA Essentials, 48-port term license	10CON-SSTCM-C92LE48	Software subscription support, 48-port	10C9200L-NW-E-24	Network Essentials, 24-port license	9C9200L-DNA-E-24	Cisco DNA Essentials, 24-port term license	9C9200L-DNA-E-24-5Y	Cisco DNA Essentials, 24-port, 5-year license	9CON-SSTCM-C92LE24	Software subscription support, 24-port	9CON-SSSNT-C92L24PX	Support for Catalyst 9200L 24-port PoE+	9CAB-TA-NA	North America AC power cable	19PWR-C5-BLANK	Config 5 power supply blank	19C9200L-STACK-KIT	Catalyst 9200L stack module kit	19C9200-STACK	Catalyst 9200 stack module	38STACK-T4-50CM	50 cm Type 4 stacking cable	19NETWORK-PNP-LIC	Network Plug-and-Play Connect license	19Lindop District 92  may request clarification of a bid before making an award.

service_requests.function: Internet Access and Data Transmission Service
Wireless Access Points and Necessary Software and Licenses
service_requests.description: As part of the ongoing infrastructure upgrades within the Groton-Dunstable Regional School District, reliable wireless internet access is essential to support students, teachers, and staff connecting to district technology resources and the internet throughout our schools.The District has historically followed an approximately five-year wireless access point replacement cycle, including associated hardware, software, licensing, warranty, and support. For the upcoming funding year, the District intends to replace 90 wireless access points as part of this lifecycle replacement at the Groton-Dunstable Regional High School.The District is seeking 90 Extreme Wireless access points, or equivalent, that are compatible with the District's existing Extreme Wireless infrastructure and cloud management environment. The proposed solution shall include the following:- 85 classroom/standard-density access points, such as the Extreme AP4020 or equivalent.- 5 high-density gymnasium access points, such as the Extreme AP5020 or equivalent.- Access points shall support Wi-Fi 6E or newer technology, including operation across the 2.4 GHz, 5 GHz, and 6 GHz bands.- Standard access points shall provide a minimum 2x2:2 radio configuration with software-defined/programable radios capable of supporting the 2.4 GHz, 5 GHz, and 6 GHz bands concurrently or through configurable operating modes. The Extreme AP4020 provides three 2x2:2 radios across these bands.- High-density access points shall provide a minimum 4x4:4 tri-radio configuration supporting the 2.4 GHz, 5 GHz, and 6 GHz bands. The Extreme AP5020 provides 4x4:4 radios across all three bands and is designed for high-density environments such as schools and large gathering spaces.- The access points shall support cloud-based management and integration with the District's existing wireless management environment.- The solution shall include a five-year warranty and applicable software/cloud licensing and support for the access points.- Mounting brackets and associated hardware required for installation shall be included.- Access points shall support the District's existing Ethernet and Power over Ethernet infrastructure, including 802.3at or better, as applicable to the proposed equipment.The proposed equipment shall be current-generation hardware and shall provide an upgrade path for continued wireless infrastructure support.Replacing this critical network hardware will continue to support instructional and operational technology, including student Chromebooks and staff laptops, tablets, interactive displays, mobile devices, and other network-connected equipment.

service_requests.description: Buffalo City School District is seeking Category Two Internal Connections equipment and associated eligible manufacturer support for its FY2027 Network Switch Refresh Project, as detailed in BID 27-0627-062  Network Switch Refresh Parts. The procurement includes network switches, direct-attach cables, SFP+ transceivers, and associated FortiCare Premium and Essential support, or equivalent products and services compatible with the District's existing network infrastructure.The District has posted a Request for Bid through its Bonfire procurement portal. Please refer to the attached BID 27-0627-062 specifications for the equipment descriptions, manufacturer part numbers, quantities, technical requirements, and other procurement information.Additional documents, required forms, bid tables, submission instructions, and any addenda associated with this solicitation are available through the District's Bonfire portal at:https://buffaloschools.bonfirehub.com/portal/?tab=openOpportunitiesAll questions regarding this procurement must be submitted through the Bonfire portal in accordance with the published solicitation schedule. The District encourages electronic bid submissions through Bonfire; bidders must follow the submission requirements and permitted methods specified in the solicitation.All proposals must comply with the applicable E-Rate competitive bidding requirements. Bidders must identify any ineligible products or services and provide appropriate cost allocations. Price will be the primary factor in the evaluation of E-Rate-eligible products and services.Interested vendors must review the complete solicitation and all associated documentation available through Bonfire before submitting a response.

service_requests.description: IMPORTANT INFORMATION: Form 470 figures are estimates. Poplar Creek Library District is seeking proposals for the purchase, installation, and engineering of the following items at both the Main Library and the Sonya Crawshaw Branch. Price these items out per location. Include pricing for IPSEC VPN deployment labor with firewall migration and installation. Equipment must, at a minimum, meet the following specifications or their equivalent: Line Item 1:- +/-2 Fortinet Fortigate 201G firewalls, SKU FG-201G, or equivalent. - +/-2 FortiGate-201G 3 Year Unified Threat Protection (UTP), SKU FC-10-F2H1G-950-02-36, or equivalent.- +/-4 Fortinet 10GE SFP+ transceiver module, SKU FN-TRAN-SFP+SR, or equivalent.- +/-1 Fortinet FortiClient ZTNA, SKU FC110EMS05-426-01-36, or equivalent. One FortiClient subscription pack can cover both library sites.Line Item 2:- +/-2 Aruba 10G SFP+ LC SR 400m OM4 MMF C-class Transceiver, SKU S2P30A, or equivalent.Additional Items:- Proposals should be submitted to the form 470 contact.-  Vendor is responsible for providing their Service Provider Identification Number (SPIN).- All bids received must be specific for services requested on this Form 470. Proposals should be quoted in full or can be determined to be disqualified.- Please include any necessary licensing or software needed for equipment.- Basic Maintenance has been selected to cover any software or licensing needs.- Prices quoted should be firm and should include all shipping costs as a line item within the proposal including a breakout per location.Note: Any e-rate ineligible products, services or components bundled with eligible products or services must be listed separately from the eligible products or services; failure to do so can lead to rejection of the bid/quote. Vendor must provide eligibility percentage of portions of plans that are deemed ineligible. Proposer's response must include hardware and any applicable warranty requirements.

service_requests.function: Wireless Access Points and Necessary Software and Licenses
service_requests.description: We have an Extreme Networks backbone and would like to stick with the same brand throughout.  We are looking for the following equipment, licensing and professional services:(1)  102 - AP4020s(2)  5 - AP5020s(3)  5 - Indoor Mounts(4)  107 - Extreme Platform One Licensing for APs(5)  30 - License Upgrade for our existing Extreme Switches so everything can be on the Extreme Platform One(6)  2 - License Upgrades for our existing Core Switches so everything can be on the Extreme Platform One(7)  Professional Services to configure and fine-tune the wireless networks.All equipment shall be in new condition and include at minimum a full 1 year replacement warranty.  All bidders are required to do a walk-through before a proposal will be considered.  If equipment is different from what is requested, documentation must be provided with the proposal demonstrating that the proposed equipment is equivalent and will function properly in our environment or the proposal will not be considered.  The bidder shall provide their SPIN in their proposal and shall provide documentation that they are an authorized reseller of the equipment being proposed.  If an operating license is required, it should be for 5 years and shall not include any additional components such as support or management.  Complete descriptive literature must accompany equivalent bids.  Samples will be requested if necessary.  Bid price shall include delivery to the point of use.  Where is shall be deemed necessary by school officials, the successful bidder shall be prepared to provide instruction in use and care of equipment delivered in both written form and on a demonstration basis.  Optional accessories necessary for the basic use of equipment shall be included in the base bid.  Such accessories not necessary for the basic use but deemed desirable shall be included as an alternative bid with a complete description.  Delivery date is a part of the bid and must be submitted on the bid form at the time of bidding.  All bids shall be submitted addressed to Makalia Weber and be placed in sealed envelopes clearly marked with the words "Carey Exempted Village Schools Access Point Upgrade Summer 2027", a detailed bid, and the name of the bidder.  The deadline for submitting a proposal will be midnight of February 3rd, 2027.  The applicant reserves the right to reject bids that are received after that day.  The bid opening will take place on Friday, February 5th, 2027 at 9AM in the Board of Education Offices.

service_requests.function: Internet Access and Data Transmission Service
service_requests.description: Galaxy Education Inc. dba Discovery Academy of Science is requesting Internal Connections for the following network equipment for our NEW campus at 2566 Two Ridges Road, Wesley Chapel, FL 33543. Access Points - 25 UNIFI U7 PRO MAX or equivalent - Wi-Fi 7 indoor access points providing full coverage of all instructional spaces, offices, cafeteria, media center and gym, plus limited outdoor/covered-walkway coverage. Preliminary estimate based on one AP per classroom plus common areas; final count pending floor plans.Routers - 2 UNIFI DREAM MACHINE or equivalent - Edge/border router if not integrated with the firewall or provided by the Category 1 service provider.Racks - 4  - No Preference - Equipment racks/cabinets with cable management for the MDF and each IDF closet. Preliminary estimate.UPS - 4 APC SMT3000RM2UC Smart-UPS 3000VA Rackmount or equivalent - Rack-mounted uninterruptible power supply / battery backup for the MDF and each IDF closet. Preliminary estimate.UPS - 3 APC Smart-UPS SMT1500RM2UC 1500VA Rackmount or equivalent- Rack-mounted uninterruptible power supply / battery backup for the MDF and each IDF closet. Preliminary estimate.UPS - 10 APC Back-UPS Pro 1500VA or equivalent - Uninterruptible power supply / battery backup for office use.ALL Category 2 items above are for the NEW campus at 2566 Two Ridges Road, Wesley Chapel, FL 33543 only. Installation, configuration and activation of the equipment should be included in each bid and priced as a separate line item. Quantities marked (est.) are preliminary and will be finalized from the architectural and low-voltage drawings before the Form 471 is filed.All proposals must be sent to Salih Sen <[redacted]> as well as to [redacted]. Responses that are not sent to this address will not be considered.  Although not a mandatory requirement, service providers should indicate if they are willing to invoice USAC directly, providing the school with the applicable discounts on their monthly billing.  The email subject of your response should be titled with the school name and Form 470 # for which you are bidding; responses without this subject will not be considered. Bidders should provide all taxes and surcharges in the pricing.

service_requests.description: We are seeking a pair of firewalls in a redundant configuration that can support 25Gbps Internet bandwidth with all security functions enabled. Each firewall needs a minimum of (6) SFP+ interfaces and (4) GB interfaces. Security functions should include but are not limited to gateway anti-virus, intrusion prevention, and Internet content filtering. Physical interfaces must be capable of multiple virtual interfaces and firewalls must be capable of performing DHCP relay, support multiple ISP connections and allow for traffic prioritization. We are seeking all related connections and/ or accessories to support these firewalls in Enterprise production environment. We are seeking installation, maintenance and support for initial setup and first year of service.

service_requests.function: Switches and Necessary Software and Licenses
service_requests.description: The district is seeking to purchase and installaton of the equipment (or equivalent) listed on the Wynford Equipment and Cost List attached to this 470. Cost information shall be provided using this spreadsheet.  If a completed Excel spreadsheet file is not submitted, the bidders proposal will not be considered..Operation, specified features, centralized management and access to released firmware/security updates during the manufacturers supported product life must require no paid subscriptions, recurring license/cloud fees or mandatory support renewals. service_requests.function: Internet Access and Data Transmission Service
Internet Access and Data Transmission Service
service_requests.description: Library requests bids for equipment, services, and licensing for Managed Internal Broadband Services (MIBS) to support management of the library's broadband network.Requested functionality includes:- Ability to establish bandwidth quotas for individual devices/users.- Ability to monitor and track broadband usage for the entire network and individual devices/users.- Ability to prioritize, limit, or block broadband access for individual devices.- Content filtering and malware-blocking functionality. Any ineligible content-filtering or other ineligible functionality must be separately identified and priced.- Equipment, software, and licensing necessary to provide the proposed MIBS solution.- For all proposed equipment, bids must provide the manufacturer, model, and SKU/part number, as applicable.Pricing RequirementsBids must include all applicable fees and charges associated with the proposed solution, including:- Equipment costs.- Licensing/subscription costs.- Monthly recurring charges.- One-time/non-recurring charges.- Installation, configuration, and activation charges.- Equipment rental or other applicable charges.- Any other fees or charges necessary to implement and operate the proposed solution.The cost of E-Rate-eligible services/equipment must be separated from the cost of ineligible services/equipment. If licensing is separately priced and is necessary for the operation of the proposed equipment or service, the licensing and associated cost must be clearly identified in the bid.Bids must provide sufficient information for the applicant to determine the total cost of the proposed solution.One-year and multi-year pricing may be submitted; however, a one-year pricing option is required.Vendors may bid on Category 1 and/or Category 2 MIBS services/equipment. If a vendor proposes both Category 1 Internet service and associated Category 2 MIBS, the bid must clearly identify whether the Category 2 service/equipment is required as a condition of obtaining the proposed Category 1 service. Category 1 and Category 2 costs must be separately identified.Bid Requirements and Disqualifying FactorsTo be considered responsive:- The bid must specifically address the services and requirements identified in this FCC Form 470.- The bid must reference this specific FCC Form 470 and provide a proposed solution responsive to the applicant's specific requirements.- For all proposed equipment, the bid must identify the manufacturer, model, and SKU/part number, as applicable.- The bid must include complete pricing, including all applicable fees and charges.- Eligible and ineligible costs must be separately identified.- The bidder must have a valid SPIN/498 ID.- The bidder must be willing to provide discounted billing and invoice USAC using the Service Provider Invoice (SPI) method.- The bid must be received no later than 30 calendar days after the FCC Form 470 is posted.Generic advertisements, flyers, marketing materials, mass-distributed solicitations, generic price lists, SPAM/robobids, automated responses, or other responses that do not specifically address this FCC Form 470 and the applicant's requested services will be considered non-responsive and will be disqualified from consideration.Bids that do not provide the required manufacturer/model/SKU information, complete pricing, or all applicable fees and charges, or that require the applicant to contact the bidder to obtain basic pricing or determine what equipment/service is being proposed will be considered non-responsive and will be disqualified from consideration.Bids received after the stated 30-calendar-day deadline will be disqualified from consideration.

service_requests.description: Library requests bids for equipment, services, and licensing for Managed Internal Broadband Services (MIBS) to support management of the library's broadband network.Requested functionality includes:- Ability to establish bandwidth quotas for individual devices/users.- Ability to monitor and track broadband usage for the entire network and individual devices/users.- Ability to prioritize, limit, or block broadband access for individual devices.- Content filtering and malware-blocking functionality. Any ineligible content-filtering or other ineligible functionality must be separately identified and priced.- Equipment, software, and licensing necessary to provide the proposed MIBS solution.- For all proposed equipment, bids must provide the manufacturer, model, and SKU/part number, as applicable.Pricing RequirementsBids must include all applicable fees and charges associated with the proposed solution, including:- Equipment costs.- Licensing/subscription costs.- Monthly recurring charges.- One-time/non-recurring charges.- Installation, configuration, and activation charges.- Equipment rental or other applicable charges.- Any other fees or charges necessary to implement and operate the proposed solution.The cost of E-Rate-eligible services/equipment must be separated from the cost of ineligible services/equipment. If licensing is separately priced and is necessary for the operation of the proposed equipment or service, the licensing and associated cost must be clearly identified in the bid.Bids must provide sufficient information for the applicant to determine the total cost of the proposed solution.One-year and multi-year pricing may be submitted; however, a one-year pricing option is required.Vendors may bid on Category 1 and/or Category 2 MIBS services/equipment. If a vendor proposes both Category 1 Internet service and associated Category 2 MIBS, the bid must clearly identify whether the Category 2 service/equipment is required as a condition of obtaining the proposed Category 1 service. Category 1 and Category 2 costs must be separately identified.Bid Requirements and Disqualifying FactorsTo be considered responsive:- The bid must specifically address the services and requirements identified in this FCC Form 470.- The bid must reference this specific FCC Form 470 and provide a proposed solution responsive to the applicant's specific requirements.- For all proposed equipment, the bid must identify the manufacturer, model, and SKU/part number, as applicable.- The bid must include complete pricing, including all applicable fees and charges.- Eligible and ineligible costs must be separately identified.- The bidder must have a valid SPIN/498 ID.- The bidder must be willing to provide discounted billing and invoice USAC using the Service Provider Invoice (SPI) method.- The bid must be received no later than 30 calendar days after the FCC Form 470 is posted.Generic advertisements, flyers, marketing materials, mass-distributed solicitations, generic price lists, SPAM/robobids, automated responses, or other responses that do not specifically address this FCC Form 470 and the applicant's requested services will be considered non-responsive and will be disqualified from consideration.Bids that do not provide the required manufacturer/model/SKU information, complete pricing, or all applicable fees and charges, or that require the applicant to contact the bidder to obtain basic pricing or determine what equipment/service is being proposed will be considered non-responsive and will be disqualified from consideration.Bids received after the stated 30-calendar-day deadline will be disqualified from consideration.

service_requests.function: Uninterruptable Power Supply/Battery Backup and Necessary Software and Licenses
service_requests.description: Send bids to [redacted] AND [redacted] by December 11, 2026 at 10:00 AM PST. Please reference North Monterey County Unified School District C2 470 #260001792 in the subject line. The applicant is seeking Antennas, Connectors, and Related Components, Uninterruptable Power Supply/Battery Backup and Necessary Software and Licenses, Racks, and Basic Maintenance of Internal Connections for above serving for 9 sites. Multiple function and service types have been added as well as quantities increased as a precaution in the event that any services may be reclassified by USAC as needed during the application review process. The applicant has standardized on the APC and Chatsworth platforms; however, equivalent products are acceptable. If proposing an equivalent product, please submit data verifying equivalency with proposal.  Vendor Selection Criteria: The applicant will abide by USAC/E-rate rules relative to selection criteria. Specifically, the applicant will use the price is the highest weight in their evaluations to follow the requirements of the FCC (price being primary factor FCC 54.503) Selection Criteria will be (but not limited to): 1. Cost of eligible goods and services (the highest weights) 2. Cost of ineligible goods and services 3. Vendor quote accurate relative to the RFP and meets technical specifications and design or bid requirements  4. Experience with E-Rate/Applicant/References 5. Financial stability. Vendor Information requests must reference this Form 470 number and should be emailed to the Technical Contact listed on this form no later than 10 AM PST November 20, 2026. It is important that service providers read the attached document to fully understand this project and prepare a more directed bid.  Please reference Form 470 #270001918 on all correspondence.  This request is for network equipment (firewall, access points, switches, licenses, and cabling).  USAC has advised applicants to include all three types of service for each Category 2 line item listed in Appendix A of the RFP document.Holy Family School (the Applicant) is seeking proposals for a project to supply and install network equipment at its eligible locations.  Bidders are advised that this project will be contingent upon the successful obtaining of Category 2 E-Rate funding, and the contract agreement between the district and the successful bidder must recognize that contingency.   The Applicant seeks an agreement that allows it to work with the selected vendor to adjust quantities and/or scale back or cancel the project entirely as needed based upon funding availability and/or the best interests of the Applicant.Questions/Site Visits: Any questions related to the technical aspects of this document should be directed to Amy Huber, Principal at [redacted], no later than 12:00pm EST on Wednesday, 10/28/2026.Please copy E-Rate Consultant Steve Renzino at [redacted] on all questions, proposals, and general communication. Answers to any written questions or any additional information, revisions, or clarifications to the RFP will be provided in the form of an addendum to be posted with the FCC Form 470 on the Universal Service (E-Rate) website.  It is the sole responsibility of the Service Provider to check for any addenda that may be issued.Proposal Delivery:The Applicant reserves the right to reject each and every bid, and to waive informalities, irregularities, and errors in the bidding to the extent permitted by law.  This includes the right to extend the date and time for receipt of bids.  In the event that a responsible bid is not received or if it is determined that the low bid received is too high, the bid received will be rejected and the project will be cancelled or rebid.  Bids should be emailed to the office of Amy Huber at [redacted] by 12:00pm EST on Tuesday, 12/1/2026.Please copy E-Rate Consultant Steve Renzino at [redacted] on all questions, proposals, and general communication. Please see the RFP Appendix A for a list of equipment.

service_requests.function: Firewall Service, Components, and Necessary Software and Licenses
service_requests.description: This coming funding year will be the last phase for the school's network upgrades.  The goal is to bring the school to Cisco Meraki standardization.  First, the aging Watchguard firewall will need to be replaced with a Cisco Meraki MX95 (or equivalent) appliance with the necessary components, software and licenses.  We will be replacing our aging Aruba WAP infrastructure (5-7 years old) with Cisco Meraki Catalyst 9164I (or equivalent) AP access points (a wifi survey was completed last year and called for 38 access points which is the number we are replacing).  Lastly, the school fiber backbone will need to have new cable runs (4 in total) that will allow for 10G connections to the core switch fabric.What we are looking for (or equivalent):QTY (1) MX95-HWQTY (1) LIC-MX95-SDW-3YQTY (1) MA-PWR-CORD-USQTY (1) MA-SFP-10GB-SRQTY (38) CW9164I-MRQTY (38) LIC-ENT-3YRQTY (4) Fiber cable runs from IDF's to MDF

service_requests.function: Internet Access and Data Transmission Service
service_requests.description: Library requests bids for equipment, services, and licensing for Managed Internal Broadband Services (MIBS) to support management of the library's broadband network.Requested functionality includes:- Ability to establish bandwidth quotas for individual devices/users.- Ability to monitor and track broadband usage for the entire network and individual devices/users.- Ability to prioritize, limit, or block broadband access for individual devices.- Content filtering and malware-blocking functionality. Any ineligible content-filtering or other ineligible functionality must be separately identified and priced.- Equipment, software, and licensing necessary to provide the proposed MIBS solution.- For all proposed equipment, bids must provide the manufacturer, model, and SKU/part number, as applicable.Pricing RequirementsBids must include all applicable fees and charges associated with the proposed solution, including:- Equipment costs.- Licensing/subscription costs.- Monthly recurring charges.- One-time/non-recurring charges.- Installation, configuration, and activation charges.- Equipment rental or other applicable charges.- Any other fees or charges necessary to implement and operate the proposed solution.The cost of E-Rate-eligible services/equipment must be separated from the cost of ineligible services/equipment. If licensing is separately priced and is necessary for the operation of the proposed equipment or service, the licensing and associated cost must be clearly identified in the bid.Bids must provide sufficient information for the applicant to determine the total cost of the proposed solution.One-year and multi-year pricing may be submitted; however, a one-year pricing option is required.Vendors may bid on Category 1 and/or Category 2 MIBS services/equipment. If a vendor proposes both Category 1 Internet service and associated Category 2 MIBS, the bid must clearly identify whether the Category 2 service/equipment is required as a condition of obtaining the proposed Category 1 service. service_requests.function: Internet Access and Data Transmission Service
Wireless Access Points and Necessary Software and Licenses
service_requests.description: PROJECT OVERVIEW:Essex Fells Elementary School is seeking competitive proposals for Category 2 Internal Connections and Basic Maintenance to upgrade its campus wireless network infrastructure. Equipment and services sought include approximately 28 Wi-Fi 6E Wireless Access Points, 1 Wireless Gateway / Controller (32 AP / 2k client capacity), mounting hardware, 1-year basic support/warranty, and professional installation, configuration, testing, and system deployment services.EQUIPMENT EQUIVALENCY & RFP ATTACHMENT:Detailed specifications, quantities, and scope of work are provided in the attached RFP document. Benchmark manufacturer models (HPE Aruba) are referenced solely to establish technical standards. Proposals for equivalent or superior functional products from any manufacturer will be accepted and evaluated equally.DISQUALIFICATION FACTORS:Bids may be disqualified prior to evaluation if they fail to meet any of the following mandatory conditions:Failure to possess an active USAC Service Provider Identification Number (SPIN) and Form 498 on file.Bidders on FCC "Red Light" status or suspended/debarred from participating in the E-rate program.Proposals received after the mandatory minimum 28-day bidding deadline posted on this Form 470.Failure to submit itemized pricing separating E-rate eligible products/services from any ineligible costs.SPAM, automated robotic responses, or bids that fail to address the specific scope of work outlined in the attached RFP.SUBMISSION & INQUIRIES:All vendor questions and bid responses must be submitted via email to the contact specified in the attached RFP document.
