service_requests.function: Wireless Access Points and Necessary Software and Licenses
service_requests.description: Please reference Form 470#270003009 on all correspondence. You must refer to the attached RFP document for full details. Please address Technical questions to the Technical Contact. North Daviess Community Schools is seeking proposals for a project to supply and install network equipment at its eligible locations.  Bidders are advised that this project will be contingent upon the successful obtaining of Category 2 E-Rate funding, and the contract agreement between the district and the successful bidder must recognize that contingency.   This RFP covers all three aspects of Category 2  Internal Connections, Basic Maintenance of Internal Connections (BMIC) and Managed Internal Broadband Services (MIBS)All cost proposals must reflect any available governmental unit discounts. Each line item on proposal should clearly list Quantity, Manufacturer, Part Number, Description, Unit Price, and Extended Price.Proposals MUST separate eligible and ineligible services by line item for all services to which service provider responds.If a product includes mixed functionality, please indicate the allocation for each function (i.e. 60% Internal Connections and 40% BMIC).  Vendors may submit alternative equipment as long as the equipment is an equivalent make and model or serves a similar functionality. Please note: USAC has advised applicants to include all three types of service on each Category 2 Form 470.  MIBS was listed above in case USAC deems any of the necessary software licenses to fit that category.QuestionsNo informational meetings or building visits will be scheduled.   Any questions related to the technical aspects of this document should be directed to Dr. Barry Stone, Director of Curriculum and Technology, [redacted] with a copy to [redacted], no later than 1:00 p.m. EST on November 16, 2026. Answers to any written questions or any additional information, revisions, or clarifications to the RFP will be provided in the form of an addendum to be posted with the FCC Form 470 on the Universal Service (E-Rate) website.  It is the sole responsibility of the Service Provider to check for any addenda that may be issued.Proposal DeliveryThe district reserves the right to reject each and every bid, and to waive informalities, irregularities, and errors in the bidding to the extent permitted by law.  This includes the right to extend the date and time for receipt of bids.  In the event that a responsible bid is not received or if it is determined that the low bid received is too high, the bid received will be rejected and the project will be canceled or re-bid. Bids should be e-mailed to the office of Dr. Barry Stone, Director of Curriculum and Technology at [redacted] with a copy to [redacted], by 1 p.m. EST on December 16, 2026.

Switches, switch licenses, network equipment to support Category 2 broadband service and/or WiFi access. Refer to RFP section(s) "Network Equipment" & "APPENDIX 3" in associated RFP document for equipment list and details. Equipment is needed to AUGMENT EXISTING MRSD'S network infrastructure. If proposing alternatives or substitutes, vendors should refer to "APPROVAL OF SUBSTITUTIONS AND ALTERNATIVES FOR FUNCTIONALLY EQUIVALENT ITEMS"" section in the associated RFP for details. MRSD reserves the right to award all network equipment to one vendor. All equipment included in the vendors proposal must be new and from an authorized reseller of the manufacturers product for which they are quoting. No refurbished or grey-market gear will be accepted. The bid documents must be received by Tuesday, December 22, 2026, at 2:00:00 PM (Pacific) or earlier, in a sealed envelope, identified by bid identifier MRSD E-Rate Year 2027 RFP Bid # MRSD-ERATE-2027-RFP-01, and addressed to Richard Lopez, Superintendent Merced River Union Elementary School District, 4402 W. Oakdale Road, Winton, CA 95388.. MRSD shall use the official U.S. time that is provided by the website https://www.time.gov to determine if the submission has met the deadline. NOTE: It is the total responsibility of the Vendor to return bids to MRSD by the required date, time, and place. The MRSD District Office hours are 7:30 AM - 4:00 PM Monday through Friday. The MRSD District Office is closed weekends and holidays: November 11, 26 and 27, 2026; December 24, 25, and 31, 2026; January 1 and 18, 2027. MRSD cannot receive bids after office hours or when the office is closed. If bids are to be delivered via common carrier or delivery services, vendors are cautioned that express next day am delivery is generally not guaranteed in Winton. LATE BIDS WILL BE REJECTED.. BIDS SENT VIA EMAIL, FAX, AND/OR ELECTRONICALLY WILL BE REJECTED. Vendors must read RFP package for details. Please refer to RFP package for submission procedure(s) and details.

Bids shall include specific make and model of equipment, as well as the SKU of each piece of equipment. Bids must specify terms of the manufacturers warranty and what the license term is (if applicable). Any cost ineligible for E-Rate reimbursement must be clearly identified and itemized on the bid.If submitting a bid for equipment that is or equivalent to equipment listed on this form 470, the service provider shall submit evidence of equivalency.  The applicant will make a final determination of equivalence and interoperability with existing equipment.The make/model bid(s) must be for new equipment that is the most current model(s) available.If the bid includes software licenses, the bid shall designate whether the licenses are internal connections (IC) or if the software licenses are basic maintenance of internal connections (BMIC).If the bid includes installation for new equipment, the bid must specify the installers city and state.Bid evaluations may include points for service providers with a local presence or office within 150 miles. Bid evaluations may include points for service providers who provide a complete solution. e.g., the bid presented is inclusive of all requested components and services. Details of the Cabling project can be found in the Associated RFP document.If too few bids are received in this window, applicant may extend that timeline with appropriate vendor noticeWe encourage all vendors to carefully read the posted specifications and instructions.  Failure to comply with these general specifications may be grounds for disqualification and award may be made to the next most cost-effective provider.	Cabling proposals should be as detailed as possible and provide a breakdown of costs that include:o	Materialso	Laboro	Permitting and other associated fees	Bidders should propose their Lowest Corresponding Price (LCP) (as required by the SLD 1996 Universal Service Order, 12 FCC Rcd 87, 383, para. 540) .	All proposals considered must follow State Procurement Laws	The District reserves the right to solely determine equivalency and compatibility. 	All future orders are contingent on E-rate funding and Administration approval at the discretion of the District, who reserves the exclusive right to deny any or all proposals associated with this RFP, even with E-rate funding approvals. Service Providers are responsible for providing a valid SPIN (Service Provider Identification Number) 	Per USF National Security Rule FCC 19-121 barring the use of USF funding to purchase equipment for E-rate purposes, Service Providers are certifying that the proposed equipment is not from a company with an FCC Designation as a National Security threat.  	All products are required to be new (no grey market products) with original manufacturers warranty. Service provider must be an authorized reseller of the represented manufacturer.    	DISQUALIFICATION FACTORSo	Late submissiono	Not SLD complianto	Proposal not relevant to Services Requestedo	Proposal includes equipment from Huawei Technologies Company or ZTE Corporation.o	The Applicant reserves the right to disqualify any bid that does not follow the BIDDING INSTRUCTIONS listed aboveo	SPAM and/or robotic responses will not be considered valid responses and will be not be considered.

service_requests.function: Wireless Access Points and Necessary Software and Licenses
service_requests.description: Requesting proposals for building connections (requested in quantity not unit of feet), network cabling (requested in quantity not unit of feet), wireless access points and associated software and licenses. Offeror requested to include all necessary cabling, licenses, connectors, components, installation, configuration, travel, per diem, shipping and any other applicable fees. The applicant is seeking bundled warranty and licenses including manufacturer maintenance support services (MSS) for equipment listed in the RFP and proposed solutions may include products and services defined as BMIC and/or MIBS in the E-Rate Eligible Services list. service_requests.description: The applicants wishes to purchase 110 - Cisco CW9178I or equivalent APs.  The proposals should show installaton as a seperate cost.  Installaton, if selected, will consist of a One-for-One swap of existing APs.  The applicant has lift available for high areas..The applicant wishes to purchase Cisco Catalyst C9350-48HX-E  or equivalent switches.  The proposal should provide pricing for purchase of 6 switches and 12 switches.  Installaton and configuraton cost should be shown seperately..All equipment shall be new and shall include manufacturer warranty (three year). service_requests.function: Internet Access and Data Transmission Service
Switches and Necessary Software and Licenses
service_requests.description: Category 2Funding Year 2027Camanche CSD BEN: 132681 is requesting bids for the following E-Rate Category 2 eligible licensing.  The applicant is seeking a one year license term for this request.Data Transport Switch License(1 Units)  Meraki MX X-Large Switch License (or equivalent)(2 Units)  Meraki MS 100 Medium Switch License (or equivalent)(16 Units)  Meraki MS 100 Large Switch License (or equivalent)(3 Units)  Meraki MS 200 Large Switch License (or equivalent)(1 Units)  Meraki MS 300 Medium Switch License (or equivalent)(5 Units)  Meraki MS 300 Large Switch License (or equivalent)(1 Units)  Meraki MS 400 Medium Switch License (or equivalent)Wireless Access Point License(42 Units)  Meraki MR WAP License (or equivalent)(38 Units)  Cisco Wireless WAP License (or equivalent)Bids must itemize:(a). cost of equipment(b). cost of installation separately for each equipment grouping, if applicable; and (c). cost of taxes/fees/shipping, if applicable. Bids shall include specific make and model of equipment, as well as the SKU of each piece of equipment. Bids must specify terms of the manufacturers warranty and what the license term is (if applicable). Any cost ineligible for E-Rate reimbursement must be clearly identified and itemized on the bid.If submitting a bid for equipment that is or equivalent to equipment listed on this form 470, the service provider shall submit evidence of equivalency.  The applicant will make a final determination of equivalence and interoperability with existing equipment.The make/model bid(s) must be for new equipment that is the most current model(s) available.If the bid includes software licenses, the bid shall designate whether the licenses are internal connections (IC) or if the software licenses are basic maintenance of internal connections (BMIC).If the bid includes installation for new equipment, the bid must specify the installers city and state.Bid evaluations may include points for service providers with a local presence or office within 150 miles. Bid evaluations may include points for service providers who provide a complete solution. e.g., the bid presented is inclusive of all requested components and services. Bidders must be willing to provide E-Rate discounted billing (form 474/SPI invoicing) and to include this statement in the proposal.Robo-bids and bids sent as SPAM without regard to products and services listed on the Form 470 and/or the RFP will be disqualified and will not be evaluated.The applicant reserves the right to cancel this request for bids and to reject all related proposals.Prices need to be held firm through the duration of the 2027 E-Rate Category 2 installation period (from date of bid to September 30, 2028).This project is dependent upon receiving an E-Rate funding commitment decision letter.The deadline for service provider proposals is 9:00 am Central time, 29 days after the date this Form 470 is posted.  Bid evaluation may take place anytime after the deadline for proposals up to the last day of the E-Rate funding window.The applicant reserves the right to reject late-submitted proposals. No phone calls or texts. For documentation purposes all communication is required to be via email. Proposals must be e-mailed to the Form 470 contact. [redacted]

service_requests.description: District seeks bids on up to 35 switches and up to 150 wireless access points.  Switches must be 48-port, PoE (or higher) and WAPs must be Wi-Fi 7, PoE, centrally managed.  District currently runs on Cisco/Meraki equipment and any new equipment must be functional and optimized in that environment.  Quotes must include all necessary optics, modules, licenses, software, installation, configuration, setup, etc. or otherwise as needed for functionality.  Vendor must break out cost for each item quoted and list manufacturer part numbers, quantity and price for each.  Please note that equivalent equipment must show compatibility with existing network structure. All projects are subject to eRate fundability and Board approval.  School reserves the right to reduce project(s) after seeing quotes where eRate funding and budgets are impacted.  All questions and bids are to be directed to the tech contact listed below.    Vendors who would like to do a site visit must schedule with the tech contact; no walk-in site visits will be permitted. Vendor must be an eRate eligible provider with active SPIN listed on their bid and must adhere to all state and local guidelines and restrictions. Vendors are required by USAC to maintain sam.gov registration and maintain updated compliance paperwork with USAC; vendors who are not currently compliant may be eliminated from consideration.   SPAM and/or robotic responses will not be considered valid bid responses and will be disqualified from consideration. All bids submitted prior to the applicants vendor selection will be given equal consideration, with no award made before the close of the 28-day posting period.

SPAM and/or robotic responses will not be considered valid bid responses and will be disqualified from consideration. service_requests.function: Switches and Necessary Software and Licenses
service_requests.description: Lincoln Public Schools (BEN 120811) seeks proposals for E-Rate eligible Category Two internal connections equipment and installation for a FY2027 district network upgrade. The scope includes two modular core switch chassis with 1/10/25G SFP28 line cards, at Lincoln High School and at the Administration IDF. It also includes four 48-port Class 4 PoE access switches for new IDFs at Lonsdale, Saylesville, Central and Northern Elementary Schools, plus 25G and 10G multimode and single-mode optics. Four rack-mount UPS units will serve network equipment only. Four new 12-strand hybrid OS2/OM4 fiber runs, approximately 200 feet each, will be installed with enclosures, adapter panels and patch cords. Vendor installation is required for the core switch chassis and line cards and for all fiber cabling components. service_requests.description: --(one) RouterRequesting quotes for upgraded branch router with networking and integrated security to replace the existing WAN router & support current & future bandwidth needs. The new router must support up to 10 Gbps throughput, advanced routing and IP sec features, & both SIP based telephony capability & integration w/ the districts existing analog voice environment. Please, include licensing to operate functions compatible with current setup functionality and ready to move up to digital phone service. Current voice services provided by 4 analog circuits. Labor for Installation, configuration, & testing required. Router Specifications may include: -Capable of 10 Gbps aggregate throughput w/ advanced features enabled (routing, ACLs, QoS). -(2) 10Gigabit SFP+ ports & (4) rj45 ports. -Support for IPv4/IPv6 routing, static routing, OSPF/OSPFv3, & policy based routing. -Support for NAT/PAT, DHCP services, QoS, & ACLbased security. -SNMP, Syslog, SSH, & role based administrative access. -Compatible w/ districts existing Cisco network switches, phones & 10Gbps backbone. -Supports SIP trunk routing functionality for future VoIP migration. -Must operate alongside the existing analog voice router (vendor does not need to terminate analog lines). -Must be rackmountable & include dual power supplies, if available. Equivalent to Cisco C8375-E-G2 with the required modules to connect to current network. Installation & Configuration: -Delivery, rack/stack, cabling, & optics installation (SFP/SFP+). -WAN configuration to ISP specifications. -Routing, QoS, NAT, ACL, & management configuration. -Enablement of SIP trunk routing features for future use. -Integration w/ the districts existing analog voice router architecture. Testing & TurnUp: -Bandwidth/performance validation. -Routing  tests. -Verification of management access, logging, & monitoring. Documentation & Training:-Asbuilt documentation, include final configuration files. -Administrator training session (operational basics, backups, monitoring). Include 5-year licenses. Provide 3-year warranty & software support. Must separate Erate eligible & ineligible costs.--Antennas, Connectors	(4)Four 10G multimode SFP+ transceivers.Must be compatible w/ the router on this form 470

Firewall Service, Components, and Necessary Software and Licenses
service_requests.description: Anne Arundel County Public Schools (AACPS) is seeking proposals for the following products.  These products are known to meet the needs and specifications of AACPS and are compatible with the existing network infrastructure.  In accordance with E-Rate program rules, AACPS will accept and consider proposals for equivalent products.  If proposing equivalent products, your proposal MUST include documentation comparing the features and specifications of the products listed below to your proposed products.  Proposals for equivalent products that do not include this documentation will be disqualified.iboss IB-ZT-COMPLETE-FWaaS-1Y - Qty 100,000iboss IB-60000GBCS-FWaaS-EDU-1YR - Qty 1iboss Content Filtering Add-On for FWaaS-1Y - Qty 100.000iboss - Zero Trust Add On - BI-30 - 1YR - Qty 1iboss - Mission critical support - 1YR - Qty 1------------------------------------------------------------------Evaluation of proposals The price of the eligible products and services will be given primary consideration in compliance with E-Rate program rules. Consideration will also be given to vendors providing the proposed products as follows:-	Proposed under a state, cooperative, or other procurement vehicle that may be utilized by AACPS, valid through at least 6/30/2028.-	Proposed products' seamless integration and implementation into the existing AACPS network environment.-	Vendor's experience with AACPS.-	Cost of ineligible goods and services that are proposed.-	Vendor has an E-Rate Program SPIN number.-------------------------------------------------------------------	All proposals and/or questions should reference the Form 470 number and should be submitted via EMAIL (no phone calls) to the Technical Contact listed on this Form 470 and  [redacted].**  The deadline to submit questions is 11:00 AM Eastern Standard Time on November 12, 2026.  No other questions will be addressed after this deadline.*** The deadline to submit proposals is 10:00 AM Eastern Standard Time on December 11, 2026, unless extended via Notification uploaded to this Form 470 in USAC's EPC portal.-	All proposals must include the Manufacturer and full SKU, Product Number, Model Number, etc., of the proposed products.  If awarded a contract or legally binding agreement, vendor will be required to provide the exact make and model of the proposed products, unless a substitution is approved by AACPS.-	All proposals should include a copy of a contract or legally binding agreement for the proposed products that is compliant with E-Rate program rules and regulations.-	All proposals must identify the specific products that pertain to the service request(s) listed on the Form 470.  Proposals that include an encyclopedic list of all a service provider's products, and do not identify the specific products being proposed in response to this Form 470 may be disqualified.-	At the time of proposal submission, all service providers should have a valid Service Provider Identification Number (SPIN), or be able to provide documentation showing that they have begun the process of obtaining a SPIN from USAC.  Lacking a valid SPIN, or documentation showing that the process of obtaining one has begun, at the time of submission may result in disqualification. -	As required by E-Rate rules, all bids in response to this Form 470 must offer the Lowest Corresponding Price (LCP). See USAC's website at https://www.usac.org/e-rate/service-providers/step-2-responding-to-bids/lowest-corresponding-price/ for additional information.-	Any offering of free services must be clearly identified in service providers' proposals and must be compliant with USAC's Free Services Advisory.-	This request is for a fully operational solution and should include all necessary licenses, cables, connectors, antennas, and other related components. It should be noted that all quantities are approximate, and the District reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantities based on the needs of the project.

We would like to see the cost differences between renewing our licenses compared to replacing with new access points.  There will be a separate 470 filed for renewing the licenses. While most of this project involves simply removing the old AP and installing the new one, you may have recommendations on better placements depending on the products quoted, or recommendations to add more access points for better density coverage.We are a small district with approximately 1200 students.  We are 1:1 with iPads in grade K-1 and Chromebooks in grades 2-12.  Most of our classes have around 25 students per room.  Please take this into consideration when recommending equipment to ensure appropriate coverage and device density.We also heavily use wireless presenting devices such as Airtame along with other services such as Airplay and Google Cast. service_requests.function: Wireless Access Points and Necessary Software and Licenses
service_requests.description: Cedar Cliff Local Schools seeks proposals for a district-wide wireless network refresh. The project includes indoor and outdoor wireless access points, wireless controllers/management, necessary software and licensing, cabling, mounting components, installation, configuration, and testing.  We are seeking the license under both IC and BMIC because its unclear which Service Type they may fall under.Estimated maximum quantities: 88 wireless access points, 88 licensing, 350 related components, and 28,350 feet of cabling. Quantities are planning estimates, not required purchase amounts. Vendors shall assess existing infrastructure and propose a complete, appropriately sized solution meeting district coverage and capacity needs. Proposals must identify equipment models, quantities, unit pricing, installation costs, necessary licensing, and renewal costs. Equivalent manufacturers and solutions will be considered. The district reserves the option to scale back total procurement quantities in the event that full funding for all proposed hardware is unavailable during Funding Year 2027. Therefore we are requesting an alternative proposal option for renewal of current license. Proposals must include all equipment, components, and services necessary for the proposed wireless solution to operate as described. The district is not obligated to purchase the maximum estimated quantities.MANDATORY SITE VISIT:Visitors must schedule an individual site walk-through with the district by emailing [redacted]. Review the RFP to see the dates of availability for scheduling as well as location information. Building maps can be requested prior to walk through by emailing [redacted] REQUIREMENTS:All questions must be submitted in writing by November 30, 2026. Written answers and material clarifications will be made available equally to all prospective bidders through email communication. Proposals must be emailed to [redacted] no later than 29 calendar days after this 470 posting. Late proposals will be disqualified. Vendor selection and contract award will not occur before the applicable Allowable Contract Date.Bids will be evaluated using a weighted matrix, with the price of eligible products and services as the most heavily weighted factor. The district reserves the right to award all, part, or none of the requested services and to make separate awards where appropriate. Please read the attached RFP for detailed information about our request.DISQUALIFYING FACTORS:1. Failure to complete the mandatory site walk-through.2. Failure to submit a complete proposal with equipment, descriptions, quantities, and itemized pricing by the state deadline.3. Proposed equipment must be new, compatible with the district's existing network infrastructure, and include applicable manufacturer warranties. Equivalent equipment must include sufficient technical documentation demonstrating equivalency.4. Bidders must provide their E-Rate SPIN or documentation that an application for one has been submitted.5. Contractors performing cabling work must provide evidence of appropriate insurance and any legally required bonding.6. Proposals must separately identify equipment, installation costs, required licensing, and any E-Rate-ineligible products or services.7. Service Provider Invoicing (SPI) is mandatory. The awarded vendor must agree in writing to provide discounted billing and submit FCC Form 474 directly to USAC for the eligible funded portion. The district will pay only its non-discounted share and any applicable ineligible costs. Vendors unwilling to provide SPI billing will be disqualified. BEAR reimbursement billing will not be accepted.

To be considered your bid must be loaded to the address listed above. Quantity (1) Aruba JL727A 48P 6200F Switch or equivalentQuantity (2)  APC 3000 SMTSLZ71CS UPS or equivalent Quantity (1) EcoStruxure Data Center Expert or equivalent to support up to 100 nodes.  Cloud based APC monitoring and managing program.Vendors must include their SPIN (Service Provider ID Number) in their bids. Any bids missing this info will not be considered. NO GENERIC PRICE SHEETS ACCEPTED.Our schools are tax exemptNo refurbished equipment accepted. No end of life equipment accepted.SPI Billing is required for all services and equipment. By bidding, your company is agreeing to SPI billing. Vendors should put pricing in pre-discount amounts ONLY. DO NOT INCLUDE THE SCHOOLS DISCOUNTED AMOUNT IN THE BID. ALL BIDS MUST BE FOR NON-DISCOUNTED AMOUNTS. Bids prepared with discounted amounts will not be considered.SKUs MUST be listed in the bid for each piece of equipment being installed. This includes licensing,  power supplies, and cabling components where SKUs are available etc. This is a USAC requirement. Bids missing SKUs will not be considered.Bid proposals must include detailed breakdown including total cost for each item/equipment/service as well as the Erate eligible & non Erate eligible costs for each piece of equipment/service requested in the Form 470. Bids missing this information will not be considered.No partial bids accepted. Bids must specifically address the needs of the school for ALL of the item(s) requested in the Form 470.NO CHANGE ORDERS are permitted. NO EXCEPTIONS. If a vendor cannot provide/install said services/equipment at the agreed upon contract price in the 471, the school is not permitted to sign change orders or waivers. The school must adhere to USAC bidding regulations for the Erate process. Vendors asking for additional monies post commitment are at risk of violation of Erate rules as well as USAC and FCC sanctions.

forms.entity_name: POINT ARENA JT UN H S DISTRICT

service_requests.description: Please see Category 2 RFP for additional addresses and information. We are seeking managed internal broadband services by a 3rd party who will own all equipment and school will lease all eligible equipment in order to support full Broadband connectivity that is capable of supporting 1:1 students devices as well as all administrative duties of the staff. Vendor is responsible for supplying all necessary eligible equipment: including but not limited to: Racks, Wireless Access points, Routers, Caching, Firewall services and firewall components separate from basic firewall protection provided as standard component of a vendors internet access service,  Switches, Uninterruptible Power supply (UPS)/Battery back up (including installation and configuration of the WLAN and LAN), then subsequently providing installation, activation, and initial configuration management, operation, and monitoring of all eligible components. As well as Software supporting the eligible components used to distribute high speed broadband. Implementation of contract is contingent on a positive funding commitment. Our Admin building is a NIF-which is not Category 2 eligible. However, we would like a bid for that as well with the Mandatory walk-through. service_requests.description: PROPOSALS are due on Tuesday, December 8, 2026 by 12:00 noon CST.  The district is seeking proposals for new switches, along with all related components and warranty and service agreements. Please see RFP for details/requirements.  The selected service provider will provide the necessary hardware and optionally the Labor including design, installation and configuration will be reviewed and considered as is detailed on the RFP.  For technical questions and access information, please contact Ryan Nardiello, Assistant Director of Technology at [redacted] or [redacted].  E-rate questions must be emailed to Jerry Steinberg at [redacted]. Please indicate the Form 470 number and the school district name in the subject line.  Proposals must be emailed to Ryan Nardiello at [redacted], Mary Zarr at [redacted], Karen Applehoff at [redacted] and Jerry Steinberg at [redacted]. Please indicate the Form 470 number and the school district name in the subject line of all responses.DISQUALIFICATION FACTOR: Responses not received by the due date cited in the RFP and/or Form 470 may be disqualified.DISQUALIFICATION FACTOR: Service providers that do not clearly identify ineligible equipment and pricing may be disqualified.DISQUALIFICATION FACTOR: Responses that do not address the requirements in the RFP and/or Form 470 will be disqualified.DISQUALIFICATION FACTOR: SPAM and/or robotic responses will not be considered valid bid responses and will be is qualified from consideration.DISQUALIFICATION FACTOR: Responses that do not provide the Lowest Corresponding Price will be disqualified.Service providers submitting proposals in response to this FCC Form 470 must be in compliance with rules and orders governed by the Federal Communications Commission.  The vendor must agree to comply with rules and regulations of USAC. Vendors must be familiar with billing methods and timelines associated with USAC.  Vendor must be in good standing with the USAC and not red-lighted.  The vendor must include their SPIN number on the bid/proposal.  Service providers responding to this Form 470 should clearly identify E-rate Eligible and Ineligible equipment and pricing. Any ineligible products, services or components bundled with eligible products or services must be listed separately from the eligible products or services. Prices for these ineligible products or services must be allocated out of the price for the eligible services; failure to do so can lead to rejection of the bid. Allocations must comply with USAC rules which specify that the allocation methodology must be based on tangible criteria and reach a realistic result.  It is the Service Providers responsibility to access the Portal (EPC) to determine if there are any addenda or changes for this request--

service_requests.description: Firewall Service & Components	3-year support and license for existing Fortinet FG-600F firewall.Equivalent to FortiCare Premium and FortiGuard Unified Threat Protection (UTP). Separate E-Rate Eligible and Ineligible costs.Posted as both Internal Connections and Basic Maintenance for E-Rate compliance._____THIS PROCUREMENT IS NOT A FORMAL SEALED BID/RFP PROCESS. There are no state or local restrictions or regulations on how service providers can contact the District's technology or business manager. Arizona State Procurement Code requires a formal sealed bidding process; or purchasing from an IGA, State Master Contract, other approved cooperative purchasing contract, or compliant consortium procured contract for any procurement in excess of $100,000.00. Any quote/proposal whose total value exceeds $100,000.00 and is not linked to a current State Master Contract, other approved cooperative purchasing contract, or a compliant consortium procured contract will be disqualified by Arizona State Procurement Code. Any quotes must  comply with the underlying state master/cooperative purchasing agreement in pricing and terms. Any quote/proposal submitted that does not specifically address the services requested, is generic in nature or otherwise does not meet the requirements contained in this Form 470 and associated specifications may be considered non-responsive and may be disqualified. SPAM and/or robotic responses will not be considered valid bid responses and will be disqualified from consideration. All original contracts offered that are less than a 60 month term should include specifications that allow for annual one year extensions and/or month to month extensions at the discretion of the applicant; not to exceed a total of 60 months. Please quote all eligible and ineligible products/services separately. Any pricing proposed must comply with the FCC Lowest Corresponding Price Rule as required by the Universal Service First Report and Order, and restated in the FCC E-Rate Modernization Report and Order, adopted July 11, 2014. The FCC Lowest Corresponding Price rule prohibits an E-rate services offeror from offering or charging E-rate applicants a price higher than the lowest price that the offeror charges to non-residential customers who are similarly situated to a particular school, library, rural health care provider or consortium that purchase directly from the offeror.

forms.entity_name: THE CHRISTIAN SCHOOL AT CASTLE HILLS

service_requests.description: See attached RFP# 2027_0147_MIBS. The Christian School at Castle Hills (2216 NW Military Hwy, San Antonio, TX 78213) is seeking bids for Managed Internal Broadband Services (operation, management and monitoring) of its existing eligible internal connections for Funding Year 2027. Existing equipment to be managed: firewall, Meraki MX85 or equivalent (1); access points, Meraki MR46 or equivalent (29); access points, Meraki MR36 or equivalent (5); switch, Meraki MS130-48P or equivalent (1). Please also include pricing for on-demand additional basic maintenance (BMIC) beyond normal monthly MIBS service, estimated at 96 hours annually. A physical walkthrough is required prior to bid. Local presence within 30 miles is required. No late bids will be accepted without prior authorization. All proposals must be emailed to [redacted] and must include the Form 470 number being bid, vendor name, SPIN/498 ID, vendor address, email and phone. Bids are due by 12/07/2026. All pricing must comply with the Lowest Corresponding Price rule. Eligible and ineligible products/services must be clearly separated. Contracts are contingent upon E-Rate funding approval (FCDL). Bid evaluation criteria: price of eligible products and services 30 points; vendor reputation 20; local presence and support 20; past relationship with vendor 15; SPI invoicing method 15.

service_requests.description: See attached RFP# 2027_0163_MIBS. Covenant Christian Academy (83 Pine St, Peabody, MA 01960) is seeking bids for Managed Internal Broadband Services (operation, management and monitoring) of its existing eligible internal connections for Funding Year 2027. Existing equipment to be managed: firewall, SonicWall TZ670 or equivalent (1); switches, HPE Instant On 1960 48G or equivalent (2); switches, HPE Instant On 1930 48G or equivalent (2); switches, HPE Instant On 1830 48G or equivalent (3); switch, Cisco SG220-50P or equivalent (1); switches, Netgear GS316PP or equivalent (2); access points, HPE Instant On AP25 or equivalent (28); UPS, APC Smart-UPS 750 SMTL750RM2UC or equivalent (3); UPS, APC SMC1500-2UC or equivalent (1); UPS, Tripp Lite SMART1500RM2U or equivalent (1); UPS, APC Smart-UPS X 2000 Rack/Tower LCD or equivalent (1); racks, Tripp Lite SRW18USG or equivalent (8). Please also include pricing for on-demand additional basic maintenance (BMIC) beyond normal monthly MIBS service, estimated at 120 hours annually. A physical walkthrough is required prior to bid. Local presence within 30 miles is required. No late bids will be accepted without prior authorization. All proposals must be emailed to [redacted] and [redacted] and must include the Form 470 number being bid, vendor name, SPIN/498 ID, vendor address, email and phone. Bids are due by 12/07/2026. All pricing must comply with the Lowest Corresponding Price rule. Eligible and ineligible products/services must be clearly separated. Contracts are contingent upon E-Rate funding approval (FCDL). Bid evaluation criteria: price of eligible products and services 30 points; vendor reputation 20; local presence and support 20; past relationship with vendor 15; SPI invoicing method 15.
